predictions.title: Stale Chainlink rounds can remain trusted for collateral valuation
predictions.description: ChainlinkOracle reads AggregatorV3Interface.latestRoundData and the available evidence only indicates rejection of negative answers. There is no demonstrated validation of updatedAt, answeredInRound, round completeness, or a maximum feed age before OracleFacade and RiskEngine consume the result.
predictions.impact: The attacker may obtain excess borrowing capacity or avoid liquidation using an outdated price, creating undercollateralized debt and losses for lenders.
predictions.mitigation: Require positive answer, valid round metadata, updatedAt greater than zero, answeredInRound at least roundId, and a configured per-feed maximum age. Revert or suspend valuation when freshness checks fail, and add deviation or fallback controls where appropriate.
